scope: Four stability/accessibility fixes identified in the Candidate 49 whole-program audit; recognition core unchanged.

details: Mew concrete Versatile skill is stored separately from the display label オールマイティー.
Manual completion requires choosing the concrete Versatile skill from the 12 supported candidates.
CSV preflight blocks save/copy if Mew concrete Versatile skill is unresolved; no silent blanking or guessing.
Closing the custom picker schedules flushPendingRender().
Focus restored to a closed custom-select trigger no longer counts as an active review editor.
Actual text/review editing and an open picker still defer analysis re-rendering.
Normal Pokemon require food1-food3 to be explicitly selected even when food2/food3 are not yet unlocked.
Existing mythical special handling including Mew/Darkrai explicit ― slots is preserved.
Roving tabindex keeps one option in the tab order.
Escape closes and restores trigger focus.
ArrowUp/ArrowDown on a custom-select trigger opens the picker; ArrowUp starts at the last option.
Listbox is labelled by the picker title; trigger exposes dialog relationship via aria-haspopup/aria-controls.
